items.quote: Two kinds of reaction calorimeters were used in this study. One was a Tian-Calvet type originally constructed in Marseille (TC) [76Kan], and the second was one of the Unipan type developed in
Two kinds of reaction calorimeters were used in this study. One was a Tian-Calvet type originally constructed in Marseille (TC) [76Kan], and the second was one of the Unipan type developed in
In the present investigation, therefore, thermodynamic properties of the ternary Cd-Ga-In system were measured by calorimetry and by vapor pressure.
